name: Theme Modal
description: Theme picker modal dialog. Shows two radio button groups: THEMES (Default, Monokai) and LIGHT/DARK (Dark, Light). Radio buttons are pre-checked to match current theme singleton state (theme.base, theme.mode). Cancel button dismisses without applying. Apply button reads checked radio values, calls theme.setTheme(base, mode), and closes. Escape key and overlay click dismiss. Accepts optional onClose callback. Re-renders fresh on each open() to sync radio state with current theme. Imported as singleton — only one instance exists in App.

dependencies.usage: Import { theme } singleton — read theme.base/theme.mode to pre-check radios on render, call theme.setTheme(base, mode) on apply

interface.constructor: constructor() — Creates .modal-overlay div (display:none) > .modal div (role=dialog, aria-modal=true, aria-label=Theme). Calls this.render() to build modal innerHTML with two radio groups (name='theme-base': default/monokai; name='theme-mode': dark/light), pre-checked via theme.base/theme.mode. Registers click delegation on .modal: #theme-apply → apply(), #theme-cancel → close(). Registers overlay click: if e.target === overlay → close(). Appends overlay to document.body.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Re-renders modal content via this.render() to sync radio checked state with current theme.base/theme.mode. Stores optional onClose callback. Sets overlay display:flex. Registers document keydown handler for Escape key → close().

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Queries checked input[name='theme-base'] and input[name='theme-mode'] values. If both are truthy, calls theme.setTheme(base, mode) with the read values. Then calls close().

methods.name: close
methods.description: Sets overlay display:none, removes the Escape keydown handler from document, fires stored onCloseCb if set, nulls onCloseCb.

lifecycle.created_by: App constructor — instantiated once as ThemeModal singleton
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Lives for the duration of the renderer process; overlay element stays in DOM (display toggled only)
